diagnosis: The Turborepo remote cache upload endpoint accepts teamId as a query parameter or header and writes the incoming build artifact into that team's cache storage without verifying that the authenticated user has write authorization for teamId. An attacker can poison the build cache of critical production microservices by uploading malicious compiled binaries under another team's cache namespace.

PUT /v2/artifacts/b8971cf901de38a1b2c34d5e?teamId=team_payment_service HTTP/1.1
Host: turbo-cache.infra.net
Authorization: Bearer dev_bearer_token_contractor
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
